coverage_status: Status: the primary cell (both causes) and both single-cause cells of every 00:19 treatment are estimable in every stratum, with one exception: repro-radar D4 × C2 silent (row ESS 893). Waypoints (core share 0.9982) has a single gap, A1 under both BFOs as recorded (D3, row ESS 368; 409 on the both-burst set). In free, descent-climb and repro-radar, A1 falls below the gate under D3, D4 and D5, and B under D3 (also A2 under D3 in free, and B under D4 in descent-climb). Compared with run I, the C2-silent gaps under D3 and D5 are closed in all four strata and the waypoints D3 B and D5 A1 gaps are closed. These are proposal-coverage gaps of end of flight (thin A1 mass under the two-BFO likelihoods); settling cannot close them. They are reported, not dropped. The both-burst set raises D3/D4 row ESS on waypoints only modestly (see §1) and does not close the D3 × A1 gap.
